#  | Arachne

- [About Arachne](https://blinkseq.github.io/arachne/about.md): The Lariat developers made the case that linked-read data improved alignment, especially over highly repetitive regions. This was shown to work quite well in Aedes aegypti and other works.
- [Install arachne](https://blinkseq.github.io/arachne/install.md): This assumes an environment has already been created with conda create
- [Using arachne](https://blinkseq.github.io/arachne/usage.md): Use --help or -h, or call arachne (or its subcommands) without arguments to call up the docstring.
- [RFA and EM](https://blinkseq.github.io/arachne/rfa_em.md): Arachne defaults to the EM algorithm from EMA, but provides the option --rfa to use the RFA algorithm from Lariat. This page provides some background context about the two.
